title: Critical strike
wikitext:
{{about|the game mechanic|the support gem|Increased Critical Strikes Support}} A '''critical strike''' is a type of [[hit]] that multiplies its damage by its [[critical strike multiplier]]. Critical strikes inherently gain 100% chance to [[ignite]], [[freeze]], and [[shock]]. Note that other conditions such as [[damage type]] must still be satisfied. [[Damage over time]] cannot critically strike, since it does not hit. __TOC__ ==Mechanics== When a skill is used or [[trigger]]s, it performs a critical strike roll. This roll ranges from 0 to 99.99, and determines the critical strike chance a hit must exceed to critically strike.{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=December 10, 2012|title=Mechanics thread|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/11707/filter-account-type/staff/page/10#p755973|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=February 7, 2013}} :For example: A player casts {{il|Arc}} and rolls a 12. When enemies are hit, those hits require a critical strike chance of 12.01% to become critical strikes. While hits from the same skill will usually have the same critical strike chance, resulting in all-or-nothing behaviour, conditional modifiers such as {{il|Assassin's Mark}} or {{psl|For the Jugular}} can cause critical strike chance to vary between enemies or hits. * Some skills perform a new roll per hit or stage, such as [[channelling skill]]s, {{il|Blade Vortex}}, or {{il|Orb of Storms}}. This prevents reusing a skill to 'fish' for a good roll to use over a skill's entire duration. * Sources of [[luck]] (i.e. Lucky, Unlucky, Unexciting) for critical strike chance will perform multiple rolls and keep one of the outcomes. * Bifurcated critical strikes (e.g. {{psl|Mystical Infusion}}) perform two crit rolls. If at least one of them succeeds, the hit will crit. If both rolls succeed, the critical strike's extra damage is doubled. ** Luck will apply individually to each of the two rolls. * Critical strikes from attacks may be downgraded to regular hits by [[evasion]]. ===Critical strike chance{{anchor|Critical strike chance}}=== {{redirect|Critical Strike Chance|the passive skill|Critical Strike Chance (passive skill)}} A hit's chance to crit is determined by calculating the following: {{math|formula= \text{CriticalStrikeChance} = ({\text{BaseCriticalStrikeChance} + \text{AdditionalCriticalStrikeChance}) * (1 + \text{IncreasedCriticalStrikeChance})* (1 + \text{MoreCriticalStrikeChance}) } }} '''Base critical strike chance''' is the default crit value of a skill before any additional crit chance modifiers. * For [[attack]] skills, base crit chance is usually the crit chance of the weapon used to hit. (Including {{c|mod|#% increased Critical Strike Chance}} on the weapon, which multiplies its base chance.) ** [[Unarmed]] attacks have 0% base crit by default. ** [[Shield]] skills like {{il|Shield Crush}} have their base crit listed on the gem. ** Skills that use two weapons simultaneously (e.g. {{il|Dual Strike}}) calculate each hand's crit chance and damage separately. If either hand crits, the combined hit is considered a crit. * [[Spells]] have their base crit listed on the gem. * [[Minion]]s have variable base crit depending on the minion type. '''Additional critical strike chance''' is an addition to base crit before other modifiers apply. [[Concoction]] skills receive additional crit chance from their gem. Other sources include {{stl|Brittle}}, {{il|Assassin's Mark}}, {{il|Increased Critical Strikes Support}}, {{il|Rigwald's Curse}}, and {{il|Seething Fury}}. After base and additional are added together, multipliers such as ''increased'' and ''more'' apply. For example, if the player is using a weapon with 5% chance to crit, and has {{c|mod|+1% to Critical Strike Chance}} and {{c|mod|50% increased Critical Strike Chance}}, hits will have 9% chance to crit. Effects which prevent critical strikes (ex. {{psl|Resolute Technique}}) will take priority over effects that causes you to always deal critical strikes (ex. [[Diamond Shrine]]). ===Critical strike multiplier=== {{#vardefine:character_base_crit|{{Character query|base_critical_strike_multiplier}}}} Critical strikes cause [[hit]]s to deal "extra damage" compared to a non-critical strike, the magnitude of which is determined by ''critical strike multiplier'' (i.e. crit multi). Player characters have a base crit multi value of {{#var:character_base_crit}}%, while monsters have a base crit multi value of {{Monster query|base_critical_strike_multiplier}}%, or 50% and 30% "extra damage" respectively.{{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=April 16, 2013|title=Enemy Critical Strike Multiplier Reduction|url=http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/313264/page/2#p313264|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=January 26, 2015}} ===Reduced extra damage from critical strikes=== {{c|mod|Take #% reduced Extra Damage from Critical Strikes}} modifiers multiplicatively reduce the Critical Strike Multiplier exceeding the baseline damage (100%).https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/xl6cup/comment/ipjkhrd/ Similar numerical modifiers stack additively and are capped at 100% reduced extra damage from critical strikes, which is equivalent to {{c|mod|Take no Extra Damage from Critical Strikes}}. For example, a character with 30% reduced extra damage from critical strikes against a monster will be calculated as follows: # The default critical strike multiplier for [[monsters]] is {{#cargo_query: tables=generic_stats |fields=value |where=name="Monster" AND id="base_critical_strike_multiplier" }}%, so the extra damage is 130% - 100% = 30%. # The total reduced extra damage is 30%, so multiply the extra damage by 0.7. # 30% * 0.7 = 21% extra damage. Therefore, critical strikes will be treated as if a monster has 121% crit multi instead of 130%, and will deal 21% more damage on critical strike instead of 30%. ===Ailments=== Critical strikes inherently have {{c|mod|always Ignite}}, {{c|mod|always Freeze}}, and {{c|mod|always Shock}}.https://www.reddit.com/r/PathOfExileBuilds/comments/sdfu4i/requirements_to_apply_elemental_ailments/huec1as/ These ailments can still be discarded if they do not reach the minimum ailment threshold. Damaging ailments ([[bleeding]], [[poison]], and [[ignite]]) from critical strikes do not scale with crit multi by default, but inherently have +50% to Damage over Time Multiplier, additive with other sources of Damage over Time Multiplier stats.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2627116 Allocating {{psl|Perfect Agony}} allows critical strike multiplier to scale the Damage over Time Multiplier value. [[Minions]] and [[monsters]] both have an inherent {{c|mod|+30% to Damage over Time Multiplier for Ailments from Critical Strikes}}, which is in line with, but also distinct from their default 130% [[Critical Strike Multiplier]]. ==Weapon critical strike potential== An exhaustive list of weapon base Critical Strike Chances. Weapons may have a higher base Critical Strike Chance with the proper [[Item affix]]. history == {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.16.0}} * Added a new "Critical" Gem Tag. This applies to skills which positively affect your Critical Strikes, or provides effects on Critical Strikes. * This tag can be found on the following Skill Gems: Ambush, Assassin’s Mark, Battlemage’s Cry, Bladefall, Blade Vortex, Vaal Blade Vortex, Cobra Lash, Destructive Link, Dual Strike, Frost Shield, Ice Spear, Icicle Mine, Lightning Spire Trap, Lightning Trap, Vaal Lightning Trap, Precision, Power Siphon, Vaal Power Siphon, Summon Ice Golem, and Zealotry. * The tag can also be found on the following Support Gems: Cast On Critical Strike, Awakened Cast On Critical Strike, Charged Mines, Charged Traps, Controlled Destruction, Awakened Controlled Destruction, Critical Strike Affliction, Increased Critical Damage, Increased Critical Strikes, Inspiration, Nightblade, and Power Charge on Critical. {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Removed the minimum and maximum Critical Strike Chance caps. Previously, characters had a 5% chance to deal a critical strike with attacks and spells, even when the spell specified a lower chance, and could reach a maximum of 95% chance to critically strike. }} {{Version history table row|2.2.0| * All sources of increased Critical Strike Multiplier have been changed to additional Critical Strike Multiplier. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.3| * The critical strike system has been changed so that your weapon and/or spell have a direct critical strike percentage that other things modify. For example, if you're using a weapon with 8% critical strike chance and have a total of +50% critical strikes from your passive skills and items, then you have a 12% chance to score a critical hit. The old "critical strike rating system" is gone. To clarify a common misconception - spell critical strikes do include the normal critical strike chance. * Players now have a default critical strike damage multiplier of +50%. Monsters are now set to +30%. }} {{Version history table row|0.6.0| * Fixed a bug with critical strikes occurring too often. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.6| * The wording of text to do with Critical Strikes has been improved to make it clearer. }} {{Version history table end}} [[Category:Game mechanics]] {{sister|poe2wiki=Critical hit}}
